constituentArticles.title: DPIIT revises start-up definition: Deep-tech up to 20 years and ₹300 crore
constituentArticles.text: DPIIT revised 2019 rules: Deep-tech start-ups recognized up to 20 years (turnover ₹300 Cr); non-deep-tech turnover raised to ₹200 Cr (10 years).
